amendments.historical_issue: Previous audit reports used 'COMMITTED' generically, creating confusion between scratch working-state transactions and canonical finding promotions.
amendments.amendment: Term 'COMMITTED' is now split into five distinct categories: (1) Scratch Working State Commit, (2) Canonical Investigation State Commit, (3) Accepted Finding Promotion, (4) Report Admission, and (5) Report Publication.

amendments.historical_issue: Some sections conflated FinalizationGate passing with analyst review completion or report publication.
amendments.amendment: FinalizationGate strictly evaluates investigation execution closure (no unintegrated delegations, store ok). It does not perform analyst finding review or publish final reports.
The actual physical SQLite table name is 'agent_trajectory_events'. Historical references to 'agent_trajectories' were logical shorthands.

amendments.historical_issue: RCA-2A.11a reported '336 passed' without clarifying test scope.
amendments.amendment: 336 tests passed represents the Benchmark Focused Regression (python_service/tests/unit/benchmarks/), not the entire Python unit suite (which contains 2,858 tests).
